Bengaluru Authorities Launch Crackdown on Abandoned Vehicles

The Greater Bengaluru Authority will launch a joint drive with the Bengaluru Traffic Police to remove abandoned vehicles from roads and public spaces starting July 10. The move aims to improve city infrastructure and maintain public safety. The five city corporations under the authority have cleared encroachments along 47 km of city roads, highlighting the need for a coordinated effort to address urban issues.
